title: Parameter file of tpg-rotate-credential
description: The parameter file of `argo submit --from workflowtemplate/tpg-rotate-credential --parameter-file`: the inputs of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-rotate-credential. Generated from workflows/params/types.yaml and the template by workflows/params/params_schema.py. The shape, the types, the allowed values and the mandatory inputs; the validate step of the workflow and the admission policy tpg-workflow-parameters remain the authority (inputs that are mandatory in some cases only, combinations, registered clusters, the inside of clusterMap).

secretType.description: broadcom-registry (Argo CD Helm repository, regsecret on every target, image pull test), backup-storage (backup-storage on every target, backup locations, container access), git-push (workflow clone and push), git-read (Argo CD fleet repository), monitoring-remote-write (standalone monitoring gateway credential), ca-bundle (tpg/ca-bundles/<secretName>, key caBundle) or custom (tpg/custom/<secretName>, any keys) [Enum]

secretName.description: ca-bundle and custom: the secret name under tpg/ca-bundles/ or tpg/custom/ (a Kubernetes object name) [String (name); mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

wrappingToken.description: The single-use Vault wrapping token that holds the new value (tpg-aks-infra scripts/vault-secret.sh wrap <secretType> prints it; 10 minutes). Empty: the value is already in Vault and the run only verifies it [String (Vault token); mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

caBundleFile.description: ca-bundle only, instead of wrappingToken: one PEM file of the submitting machine in brackets, [./ca.pem] (.pem, .crt, .cer; contents in patchFiles); not a repo: file [List (one file path)]

patchFiles.description: JSON map: the contents of caBundleFile, {"<path>": "<base64>"}; scripts/submit/pack-patch-files.sh -o FILE writes it [Map (JSON); mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]
